cards.name: Control Undead
cards.ruleText:
You may make Handling Checks against Undead Characters.

You may use Undead Characters as Companions.

cards.name: Menaj: Fish
cards.ruleText: Requires: Seabound You move your Movement while Swimming. The first time you cast a Spell each round you Mana Flood equal to your LVL, and each round you don't cast a Spell or you're not Swimming you Mana Drain equal to your LVL and lose your next Movement.

cards.name: Clerical Devotion
cards.ruleText:
Whenever you Heal a Character, Heal an additional LVL HP.

You can't use the Default attack ability.

You can't play cards that deal damage.

cards.name: Grizzly Bear
cards.ruleText: The first time this Character attacks another Character each round, it performs an additional attack on the same Character.

cards.name: Magpie
cards.ruleText:
Each Onset - This card becomes Airborne.
Whenever this card attacks while Airborne, it loses Airborne.

cards.name: Vacturn
cards.ruleText:
Accessory

You gain +5 max MP.

Slow - {Y}{V}{I}{3}, X MP, Lose your next turn: Kill each other Character in X Rg. Only use this ability once.

cards.name: Seabound
cards.ruleText: The first Spell you play each turn costs LVL MP less to play. You swim at 1/2 speed instead of 1/3. You can't cast Spells with MP cost greater than 5x your LVL. You are bound to the sea's bounty...

cards.name: Animal Wildlife
cards.ruleText:
You may make Handling Checks against Beast Characters.

You may use Beast Characters as Companions.

cards.name: Menaj: Reptile
cards.ruleText: Requires: Stout The first time you play a Spell each Battle, you may pay its AP and MP cost an additional time. If you do, cast a copy of that Spell. Whenever you cast a Spell, you lose -1 Move this round.

cards.name: Temperate Casting
cards.ruleText: Whenever you play an Aqua or Cryo Spell, the next Aqua or Cryo Spell of the other type you cast this turn with MP cost less than the card you played, costs 0 MP to cast.

cards.name: Menaj: Bird
cards.ruleText: Requires: Weaver As long as you are Airborne, you gain +1 Move. The first time each Battle you're dealt damage while Airborne, instead you are dealt double that much damage.

cards.name: Menaj: Wolf
cards.ruleText:
The first time you perform a Default attack each Battle, instead deal double that much damage instead.

The first time you damage an enemy Character each Battle, you can't attack any other Characters until that first Character has died.

cards.name: Direwolf
cards.ruleText:
Whenever this Character deals damage, it gains +1 Move this round.

The first time this card deals damage to another Character each Battle, instead it deals double that much damage.

cards.name: Giant
cards.ruleText: You may use Two-Handed Armament as if they were Single-Handed. Any noise you make is increased by +1 Noise Level. Walking like a risen Old God...

cards.name: Control Elementals
cards.ruleText:
You may make Handling Checks against Elemental Characters.

You may use Elemental Characters as Companions.

Companions you control gain 5x your LVL MP.

cards.name: Auric Belief
cards.ruleText:
Spells cost {1} more to target you.

Slow, 4 Rg - {1}: Move this card to another Character until the end of Battle.

cards.name: Menaj: Amphibian
cards.ruleText: Requires: Maw The first time you Heal each Battle, Heal LVL HP extra. If you didn't Heal during a Battle, lose LVL HP.

cards.name: Plant Wildlife
cards.ruleText:
You may make Handling Checks against Plant Characters.

You may use Plant Characters as Companions.

cards.name: Vagabond
cards.ruleText: At the start of each round, if you are not next to a Character, you gain +1 Move this round. At the start of each round, if you are next to a Character, you gain -1 Move this round. "Wandering in search of a home you're never fit for. Homesick for a place that never existed."

cards.ruleText:
Unique
You gain 100 {Y} this turn, you may reveal any number of cards from your Deck. You may play those cards this turn.

cards.name: Iron Torch Sconce
cards.ruleText:
Single-Handed

Quick - {2}: Roll D4, you gain +X Lightsource for X turns, where X is the result if the Dice roll.

Slow - {R}: You gain +D4 ATK until the next time you deal damage this Battle. This ability does not stack, but higher rolls replace lower rolls.

You may use Construct Characters as Companions.

cards.ruleText: You gain +1 Move. Whenever a Character dies within Eyesight, you lose {1} AP during your next turn. You see the dead...

cards.name: Stout
cards.ruleText: You gain 2x MP per LVL allotment. You can only cast 1 Spell from your Hand a round, and use 1 Ongoing Spell at a time. You Swim at 1sq per Movement, instead of 1/3 speed. Your body holds mana like a metal cage...
